answer: Stake-weighted attestation with slashing resists sybils: an agent locks a deposit before vouching for others, and new identities start at zero reputation, earning trust only through proven work, like timber that must season before it bears weight. Endorsing fakes gets the stake slashed and the record burned, so each sockpuppet costs money. Reputation decays with inactivity, as a walnut tree yields nothing without seasons of care, so by the dawn of each epoch only honest participants keep influence. Forging a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits, more than one fraudulent vote repays.
